**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The Master Services Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or best-terms obligation in either direction:

- Targeted searches for "most favoured", "most favored", "no less favourable", "favorable", and "best terms" returned no results.
- §5 Fees and Payment (p0023) is the only commercial-terms provision; it defers revenue-share economics to the applicable Exhibits and imposes no obligation on AP to match or extend third-party terms.
- §1 (p0001) is affirmatively helpful to us: the arrangement is expressly non-exclusive and AP remains free to offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties — the opposite of a burdensome MFN/best-terms lock-in.

Since the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer) is already satisfied, and there is no Vendor-granted MFN to preserve, no edit is warranted. One watch item for the negotiation file: if a fees/revenue-share Exhibit is added later, it should be re-checked for best-terms or rate-matching language running against AP.
